notes: Actual commands and public APIs only, in fresh owned private-Xvfb sessions. Existing user Rhino sessions were untouched.
The initial worker suffered a runtime access violation and published no response. Its process was confirmed absent before the host was interrupted; no result is claimed for that failed attempt.
The combined retained observation concatenates all five completed responses in original request order, after verifying identical headers and every numeric value bit-for-bit.
The exact polynomial witnesses read only generated source geometry. No observed target is passed to the native runner.
VolumeCentroid explicitly selects coordinate surface primitives and tetrahedral mesh cones for observed command parity; the geometry kernel default remains uniform physical cone integration.
Mixed open mesh/surface boundaries can enclose a box but produce a nonphysical Rhino command centroid. Both the real command and the independent uniform-cone result are retained, not conflated.
Older captures and comparison snapshots remain unchanged. The three remaining scalar Volume mismatches are printed curved-volume residuals and inward B-rep insertion reversal.
This is not a proof of all rational/trimmed open-surface parity, an explanation of the runtime access violation, or a Rhino performance comparison.
